name: ALP Moist Nicotine Pouches - 5 Flavors, 3mg, 6mg, 9mg
shortDescription: ALP Nicotine Pouches offer bold, moist tobacco-free pouches in 8 flavors with 20 pouches per can. Available in 3mg, 6mg, and 9mg strengths.
description:
Moist Pouches, Real Flavor

ALP Nicotine Pouches are tobacco-free oral nicotine pouches made with 100% synthetic nicotine. Each can holds 20 moist, slim pouches that deliver faster flavor release and quicker nicotine absorption than dry alternatives. No tobacco, no smoke, no vapor, no spit.

ALP is made by ALP Supply Co. LLC, a joint venture between Turning Point Brands and the Tucker Carlson Network. The brand launched in late 2024 and has grown fast. ALP pouches are manufactured in the United States with pharmaceutical-grade synthetic nicotine and food-grade ingredients.

Three Nicotine Strengths

ALP Nicotine Pouches come in three levels so you can match your nicotine needs:

  • 3mg. A light buzz for new pouch users or anyone cutting back on nicotine intake.
  • 6mg. The middle ground. Good for daily users who want steady satisfaction without overdoing it.
  • 9mg. The strongest option. Built for experienced users and former smokers who need a solid kick.

The 9mg strength is a key differentiator. Zyn tops out at 6mg, so ALP Nicotine Pouches give you 50% more nicotine at the highest level. The moist pouch format also speeds up absorption, meaning you feel the effect within a couple minutes of placing the pouch.

Eight Bold Flavors

ALP Nicotine Pouches come in 8 flavors, ranging from cool mints to fruit and unflavored. Here are the options:

  • Chilled Mint. Clean, cooling mint that works all day. Smooth and never harsh. The top seller.
  • Mountain Wintergreen. Bold and icy with herbal depth. A strong cooling sensation that sticks around.
  • Refreshing Chill. Light, icy mint without the intensity. Good for users who want freshness, not force.
  • Spearmint. Softer and sweeter than peppermint. Pairs well with coffee or food.
  • Peppermint. Fresh, icy, and smooth. A classic mint experience with a sweet finish.
  • Tropical Fruit. Bright and sweet with a citrus-forward kick. One of the most talked-about ALP flavors.
  • Sweet Nectar. Floral and smooth. A unique choice that has built a loyal following among pouch users.
  • Classic. Unflavored. Clean nicotine with no flavor distractions. Good for states where flavored pouches are restricted.

ALP Nicotine Pouches stand out from the pack because of the moist pouch format. That moisture makes each flavor more vivid from the first minute. Dry nic pouches like Zyn take longer to release taste. ALP delivers right away.

How To Use ALP Pouches

Place one ALP pouch between your upper lip and gum. You may feel a mild tingle as the nicotine absorbs. Leave the pouch in place for 20 to 60 minutes, then remove and toss it.

Most ALP cans include a catch lid for used pouches. No spitting required. ALP Nicotine Pouches are spit-free, mess-free, and completely smokeless. Use them at your desk, in the car, on a plane, or at the gym. Nobody around you will notice.

Pouch Comfort and Quality

ALP uses a slim, moist pouch format. The slim shape sits flat against the gum and stays put. The moist fill gives a softer feel compared to dry alternatives. No rough texture. No gritty residue.

Ingredients include synthetic nicotine, plant-based fibers, natural sweeteners, flavorings, and propylene glycol. Every ingredient is food-grade. No tobacco leaf, no stem, no tobacco-derived nicotine touches the product. ALP Nicotine Pouches do not stain teeth.

How Long Does a Can Last?

Each ALP can contains 20 pouches. That is 5 more per can than Zyn. Here is how long one can lasts based on your usage:

  • Light user (3-4 pouches/day). One can lasts about 5-7 days
  • Moderate user (5-7 pouches/day). One can lasts about 3-4 days
  • Heavy user (8+ pouches/day). One can lasts about 2-3 days

At 20 pouches per can, ALP offers better value per pouch than 15-count brands. Heavy users should grab a few cans at once. ALP also sells 5-can sleeves for bulk buyers.

This coating locks in flavor and nicotine, so your last pouch tastes as fresh as your first: even after sitting in the can for weeks.

Each can of Atom Nicotine Pouches holds tobacco-free, 6mg pouches in a sleek, compact tin. No smoke, no vapor, no spit. Place one under your lip and get clean nicotine delivery for up to 45 minutes.

One Strength, Done Right

Atom Nicotine Pouches come in a single 6mg strength. That puts them squarely in the mid-range for oral nicotine products: strong enough for daily satisfaction, mild enough to use throughout the day without overdoing it.

For context, 6mg sits between Zyn's 3mg (light) and brands like Lucy or Honcho that go up to 10mg or 12mg. If you want a balanced, consistent nicotine experience without juggling multiple strengths, Atom keeps it simple. One strength. One pellet. Every time.

Six Flavors to Choose From

Atom Nicotine Pouches come in six flavors that cover mint, fruit, and unflavored profiles:

  • Chill Mint: cool, clean spearmint with a frosty edge. A daily-driver flavor that pairs with anything.

  • Mango Pineapple: tropical blend of ripe mango and tangy pineapple. Bright and smooth from start to finish.
  • Strawberry Banana: sweet strawberry balanced with creamy banana. A mellow, easy-going flavor for all-day use.
  • Smooth: unflavored. Pure nicotine delivery with no added taste. Built for users who want the effect without the flavor.

Thanks to the pellet coating, Atom's flavors hold up longer than traditional pouches. The exterior layer protects the flavor compounds from breaking down, so you get a consistent taste from minute one through minute forty-five.

No spitting. No charging. No vapor. Atom pouches are ready to go straight out of the can. Use them at work, on a flight, at the gym, or anywhere smoking and vaping are off limits.

Atom Nicotine Pouches use a sleek, compact format designed for discretion. The pouches sit flat against your gum and stay in place. Most users forget the pouch is there after a couple of minutes.

Beri Crush 50K Disposable Vape

The Beri Crush 50K is a disposable vape that delivers up to 50,000 puffs from a 20mL e-liquid tank, with a quad mesh coil, two power modes, and a fast-charging USB-C battery. Beri built the Crush 50K around capacity and flavor. The 20mL tank holds more juice than most 50K devices, the quad coil keeps the flavor consistent, and Crush Mode is there when you want a stronger hit. The 1.77-inch screen shows your battery and puff count, so you always know where you stand.

Normal Mode vs Crush Mode

The Beri Crush 50K gives you two ways to vape:

  • Normal Mode: up to 50,000 puffs. Smooth and efficient for all-day use, with the wattage managed automatically for steady flavor.
  • Crush Mode: up to 20,000 puffs at 40W. Bigger clouds, bolder flavor, and a stronger throat hit. Switch with one click.

Normal Mode is your daily driver. Crush Mode is for when you want extra punch. You can switch anytime, and the smart wattage adapts on the fly.

Quad Mesh Coil for Better Flavor

Most disposables use a single or dual coil. The Beri Crush 50K steps it up with a quad mesh coil, so four heating elements spread the heat across a bigger surface area.

That means richer flavor and smoother vapor from the first puff to the last, without burnt hits or flavor drop-off halfway through. The adaptive wattage keeps the coil in its sweet spot no matter which mode you're in.

18 Flavors to Choose From

The Beri Crush 50K comes in 18 flavors across fruity, icy, and candy profiles. A few standouts:

  • Strawberry Cream: ripe strawberry with a creamy, dessert-like exhale.

  • Watermelon Ice: juicy watermelon with a clean icy kick.
  • Cherry B-Pop: cherry candy sweetness with a fizzy edge.
  • Grape Ice: bold grape chilled with menthol.

The full lineup also includes Banana Taffy, Green Apple, Juicy Peach, Polar Ice, Strawberry Watermelon, Summer Glacier, Super Mint, Tropical Gummy, Watermelon Refresh, and White Strawberry.

Battery and Fast Charging

The Beri Crush 50K runs on a 1000mAh rechargeable battery with USB-C charging, and it goes from 0 to 80% in about 15 minutes. That's one of the faster charge times on a disposable. The charging cable isn't included, so use any USB-C cable you already have.

Normal Mode sips power, so a charge lasts a long time. Crush Mode at 40W drains faster, so you'll plug in more often if you run it hard. The 1.77-inch display shows your exact battery level and puff count.

If you want a long-lasting disposable vape that feels different from every other 35K device on the shelf, the Psylo is built for you.

Smart Lock System and Interactive Chip. A 35K First

Most disposable vapes turn on the moment they ship. The Chillax Psylo 35K is different. It uses a built-in lock system that keeps the device fully inactive until you press the mouthpiece for the first time. This means your vape stays fresh, your battery stays charged, and there are no accidental puffs in transit. Once you wake it up, the device is ready for thousands of draws.

The Psylo also has a feature no other vape on Vape24 offers. It has an interactive chip that lights up when another Chillax Psylo user is within 10 meters of you. Dual Mode Operation: 35,000 Puffs or 20,000 Boost Puffs

The Chillax Psylo 35K runs in two power modes. You pick the one that fits your mood.

  • Normal Mode: Up to 35,000 puffs. Smooth, balanced flavor and steady vapor for everyday use.
  • Boost Mode: Up to 20,000 puffs. Bigger clouds, warmer hits, and bolder flavor for short sessions.

You can switch between modes any time. Boost Mode burns through the e-liquid faster, which is why the puff count is lower. Normal Mode stretches the same 15mL tank for the longest possible run.

15mL Crystal Tank and Dual Mesh Coil

Inside the Psylo is a 15mL prefilled e-liquid tank with a clear crystal design. You can see the juice level at a glance, so you always know how much is left. Adjustable airflow lets you tune each draw. Open it up for an airy, cloud-chasing pull. Close it down for a tighter mouth-to-lung style. The same device fits two very different vaping habits.

Jelly THCP Dabs are a solventless live rosin badder made for experienced hemp concentrate users. Each jar holds 3 grams of hemp-derived THCP badder, dosed at 1000mg of THCP per gram. That's 3000mg of THCP in the full jar. This is a dab, not an edible, so you'll need a dab rig or a concentrate vaporizer to use it.

They're built for connoisseurs who already know their way around dabs and want a rich, terpene-forward hemp concentrate. If you're new to THCP or new to concentrates, this isn't the place to start.

What Is THCP Live Rosin Badder?

Live rosin is a solventless hemp concentrate. It's pressed from fresh, frozen hemp using only heat and pressure, so there are no chemical solvents involved. Badder (also spelled batter) is the whipped, creamy texture the rosin is worked into. It's soft, easy to scoop, and holds onto the plant's natural terpenes.

Because it's solventless and terpene-rich, live rosin badder keeps the true flavor of the source strain. Jelly starts with quality hemp material and presses it into a badder that carries the strain's aroma and taste straight through to the dab. The result is a smooth, full-flavor vapor that concentrate fans look for.

How Potent Is It? 1000mg THCP Per Gram

Let's be clear about the numbers. This isn't a mild product:

  • THCP per gram: 1000mg
  • Net weight per jar: 3 grams
  • Total THCP per jar: 3000mg
  • Delta-9 THC: Less than 0.3% by dry weight (Farm Bill compliant)

THCP is reported to bind CB1 receptors far more strongly than standard Delta-9 THC. Put that in a 1000mg-per-gram concentrate meant for dabbing and you have a strongly intoxicating product. A little goes a long way. Start with a very small dab, about the size of a grain of rice, and go slow. You can always take more later. You can't take less once you've dabbed it.

Three Strain Profiles, Each With Its Own COA

Jelly THCP Dabs come in three strain profiles. Each one has its own terpene profile and its own Certificate of Analysis (COA), so you can verify the exact jar you're getting:

  • Watermelon Haze (Hybrid): a balanced hybrid profile with sweet, juicy watermelon notes. A good middle-ground flavor for hybrid fans. View COA.
  • Strawberry Runtz (Sativa): a sativa-leaning profile with candy-sweet strawberry flavor. Bright and fruit-forward. View COA.
  • Blue Berry Drip (Indica): an indica-leaning profile with rich, jammy blueberry notes. Deep and mellow on the flavor side. View COA.

All three carry the same 1000mg-per-gram THCP potency in a 3g jar. What changes between them is the terpene profile, which shapes the aroma and flavor. Effects are subjective and vary from one person to the next, so treat the hybrid, sativa, and indica labels as flavor and terpene guides rather than promises.

Why Solventless Matters

Solventless concentrates are made without butane, propane, or other chemical solvents. Live rosin is pressed with heat and pressure alone. For a lot of dab fans, that's the whole point. You get a clean, terpene-rich concentrate that reflects the source material, with no residual solvents to test for.

Jelly leans into that craft, connoisseur side. This is a badder for people who care about how a concentrate is made and how it tastes, not just how strong it is. That said, it is very strong, so the potency and the flavor go hand in hand here.

How to Use Jelly THCP Dabs

This is a concentrate for dabbing. It is not an edible and it is not for eating. Here's the basic idea:

  • You'll need a dab rig or a concentrate vaporizer. A standard pen or pod device won't work for badder.
  • Use a small dab. Scoop a rice-grain-size amount with a dab tool to start. With 1000mg/g THCP, that's plenty for a first try.
  • Go low and slow. Wait and see how you feel before taking more. Effects can be strong and can last for hours.
  • Store it properly. Keep the jar sealed, cool, and out of direct light so the badder holds its texture and terpenes.

Because the effects can be strong and long-lasting, plan your session. Don't drive or operate machinery after you dab, and don't stack more on top before you know how the first amount hit you.

Jelly THCP Dabs are for adults 21 and older who already dab and already know how their body handles potent hemp cannabinoids. They suit:

  • Flavor-focused dabbers who care about solventless, terpene-rich rosin.

Jelly THCP Dabs are hemp-derived and made to contain less than 0.3% Delta-9 THC by dry weight, which keeps them within the 2018 Farm Bill definition of hemp. THCP itself is a cannabinoid found in hemp, and this product concentrates it into a live rosin badder.

Two flavors, and JUUL describes them plainly. Virginia Tobacco is a rich tobacco flavor with earthy notes and a smooth finish. Menthol is a traditional menthol with a brisk finish.

Six Flavors With a Built-In Boost

  • Mint: crisp peppermint that sharpens when you pop the capsule. Clean, cool, and good for all-day rotation.
  • Mango: ripe tropical mango with a smooth sweetness. The burst capsule pushes the fruit flavor forward.
  • Apple Ice: tart green apple layered with a cool menthol finish. The capsule adds a juicy, wet bite.
  • Espresso: dark roasted coffee with a slight bitterness. Pairs well with an actual morning cup.

  • Apple Cider: warm, spiced apple with a hint of sweetness. Also exclusive to Breakers: you will not find it in regular Lucy cans.

Four of these flavors (Mint, Mango, Apple Ice, Espresso) overlap with the standard Lucy lineup. But Berry Citrus and Apple Cider are only available as Breakers. If those flavors interest you, Lucy Breakers Pouches are the only way to get them.

How the Capsule Works

Each Lucy Breakers Pouch holds a small, liquid-filled capsule embedded in the pouch material. Here is how to use it:

  • Step 1. Open the can and place a pouch between your upper lip and gum.
  • Step 2. Use the pouch as-is for a standard nicotine and flavor experience.

The capsule does not change the nicotine strength. It only changes flavor intensity and mouthfeel. Some users pop it right away. Others wait 10 minutes and pop it halfway through for a second wave. That flexibility is what makes Lucy Breakers Pouches a different kind of oral nicotine product.

Lucy Breakers Pouches weigh 0.53 grams each and use a slim, all-white format. They sit flat against your gum and stay put without sliding around. The pouches are spit-free. No tobacco residue, no staining, no loose material. You can use Lucy Breakers Pouches at work, on a plane, or during a workout without drawing attention. The slim shape makes them less noticeable than regular-size pouches from brands like Rogue or On!.

  • Moderate user (5-7 pouches/day): one can lasts 2 to 3 days

Each pouch delivers 20 to 30 minutes of nicotine and flavor. Pop the capsule early for maximum flavor time, or save it for a mid-session boost. A single can gives you roughly 5 to 7.5 hours of total use. Moderate users go through about 2 to 3 cans per week. Stock up with multiple cans from our nicotine pouch collection to save on shipping.

Classic Tobacco

Golden Tobacco

Vuse Alto Golden Tobacco pods deliver a smooth, lightly sweet tobacco flavor. It doesn't try to mimic a cigarette exactly: instead, it lands somewhere between a mild pipe tobacco and a toasted leaf blend. The sweetness is subtle, more caramel than sugar, and it doesn't leave an artificial aftertaste.

Golden Tobacco is the most popular Vuse Alto flavor for a reason. People switching from cigarettes tend to start here because the tobacco base feels familiar without being harsh. Long-term vapers stick with it because it's consistent: pod after pod, pack after pack, the flavor profile doesn't change.

The Vuse Alto Menthol pods hit with a clean, cooling menthol right from the first draw. It's not an icy blast that numbs your throat: it's a measured cooling sensation with a slightly sweet undertone. Think peppermint, not spearmint.

If you smoked menthol cigarettes, this is the closest pod-based equivalent you'll find in an FDA-authorized product. The menthol intensity stays consistent from start to finish. No fade, no flavor drop-off as the pod empties.

  • 5% (50mg): The higher strength. Designed for current smokers, heavy vapers, and anyone who needs a stronger nicotine hit. This is the most popular option and the one most stores stock first. If you smoke a pack a day or close to it, start here.

name: Vuse Alto Power Unit Kit - 350mAh Rechargeable Device + Magnetic USB Charger
shortDescription: The Vuse Alto Power Unit Kit includes the 350mAh rechargeable device and a magnetic USB charger. Compatible with all Vuse Alto pre-filled pods, sold separately. Draw-activated, no buttons, ready to use.
description:
What's in the Vuse Alto Power Unit Kit

The Vuse Alto Power Unit Kit includes two things: the Vuse Alto device and a magnetic USB charger. That's it. No pods, no e-liquid, no extras. If you already vape with the Alto system and need a replacement device, or you want to pick your own pods separately, this is the kit to grab.

The Vuse Alto battery is the same unit found in the All In One Kit, just without the bundled pod. It's a 350mAh rechargeable device that works with every Vuse Alto pre-filled pod on the market. Snap in a pod, take a draw, and you're good.

350mAh Rechargeable Battery

The Vuse Alto device runs on a 350mAh rechargeable battery. A full charge takes roughly 70 minutes through the included magnetic USB charger, and a single charge typically lasts through most of a 1.8mL pod before you need to plug in again.

The LED indicator on the front shows your battery level at a glance. Green means full or near-full charge. Yellow means you're getting low. Red means it's time to connect the charger. Simple, no guesswork involved.

Unlike disposable vapes that die when the battery runs out, the Alto Power Unit recharges hundreds of times. You buy the device once and just replace pods as needed. Over time, that's a significantly lower cost per puff compared to single-use disposables.

Magnetic USB Charger Included

The Vuse Alto charger uses a proprietary magnetic connection that snaps onto the bottom of the device. It's not USB-C or micro-USB, so you can't substitute a random cable from a drawer. The magnetic design is intentional though: it connects instantly, holds firm during charging, and disconnects with one hand.

The other end plugs into any standard USB port. Laptop, wall adapter, car charger, power bank: whatever you have nearby works. Since the Vuse Alto Power Unit Kit includes the charger, you're covered right out of the box.

If you lose the charger down the line, replacements are available, but it's worth keeping the included one in a consistent spot. It's the one accessory the device can't function without long-term.

Compatible with All Vuse Alto Pods

The Vuse Alto starter kit works with every Vuse Alto pre-filled pod available, including Golden Tobacco, Menthol, and any other flavors currently in the lineup. Pods click in magnetically and sit flush with the top of the device.

Each pod holds 1.8mL of e-liquid with 5% (50mg) nicotine salt. They're closed-system pods, meaning there's no filling, no coil changes, and no mess. When a pod is empty, you pull it off and snap in a fresh one. Pods are sold separately in 2-packs and 4-packs.

One thing to note: Vuse Alto pods are NOT cross-compatible with other Vuse models like the Vuse Pro or Vuse Solo. The Alto uses its own pod format, so make sure you're grabbing Alto-specific pods when you restock.

Draw-Activated, Zero Buttons

There are no buttons, no screens, and no settings on the Vuse Alto. You draw on the mouthpiece and the device fires automatically. The auto-draw sensor activates the coil instantly, delivering a consistent hit every time.

This is what makes the Alto popular with people switching from cigarettes. There's nothing to learn. If you can inhale, you can use it. Experienced vapers who want a simple backup device appreciate it for the same reason: it just works.

Available Colors

The Vuse Alto Power Unit is available in multiple device colors:

  • Blue: a solid deep blue with matte finish
  • Green: a forest green that stands out from the usual black/silver options
  • Red: bold and easy to spot
  • Slate: a neutral grey that goes with everything

All colors are the same device inside. Performance, battery life, and pod compatibility are identical across the lineup. Pick whichever one you like.

Who Should Buy the Power Unit Kit

The Vuse Alto Power Unit Kit is designed for three types of buyers:

  • Replacement buyers: your current Alto device is worn out, lost, or damaged and you need a new one without paying for a bundled pod you don't need
  • New vapers who want to choose their own pods: maybe you already know which flavor you want, or you want to buy pods and the device from different places
  • Budget shoppers: the Power Unit Kit costs less than the All In One Kit because it doesn't include a pod. If you're buying pods anyway, this saves a few dollars

If you'd rather get everything in one box, check out the Vuse Alto All In One Kit, which includes the same device plus a pre-filled pod.

Vuse Alto vs Disposables

Disposable vapes are convenient, but they add up fast. A single disposable might last 200 to 8,000 puffs depending on the model, and then it's trash. The Vuse Alto device recharges and reuses the same battery for months. You only replace the pods.

The math works out in the Alto's favor pretty quickly. A $12.99 device plus ongoing pod refills costs less per month than buying new disposable vapes every few days. It also produces less waste, which matters if that's something you think about.

What Makes the Prismatic Series Different

The Vuse Alto Prismatic Series Pods aren't just repackaged versions of the standard lineup. These pods use multi-layered flavor profiles that blend multiple taste notes into each draw. Where the regular Golden Tobacco pod delivers a straightforward tobacco flavor, the Prismatic version adds depth and complexity to the same foundation.

Three flavors are available in the Vuse Prismatic Series: Golden Spark Tobacco, Dusk Glow Tobacco, and Aqua Frost Menthol. Each one takes a familiar base flavor and builds on it with secondary and tertiary notes you won't find in the standard Vuse Alto pod lineup.

Every pod holds 1.8mL of 5% (50mg) nicotine salt e-liquid. They're pre-filled and sealed, so there's no filling, no coil swapping, and no maintenance. Pop one into your Vuse Alto device, take a draw, and the auto-draw sensor handles the rest.

Golden Spark Tobacco

Golden Spark Tobacco is a richer take on the classic Vuse Alto Golden Tobacco flavor. It starts with a warm, toasted tobacco base and layers in subtle caramel and spice undertones. If you already vape the standard Golden Tobacco pod and want something with more dimension, Golden Spark is the upgrade.

This is the flavor most cigarette switchers gravitate toward. The tobacco notes feel authentic without the harshness, and the additional warmth makes each draw feel more complete than a single-note tobacco pod.

Dusk Glow Tobacco

Dusk Glow Tobacco takes a different approach. Instead of leaning into warm spice notes, Dusk Glow builds on a darker, smoother tobacco base with earthy undertones. Think of it as the evening counterpart to Golden Spark's daytime warmth.

The profile is slightly bolder and less sweet. Vapers who prefer a robust, full-bodied tobacco experience tend to reach for Dusk Glow. It pairs well with coffee, which isn't something you can say about most pod flavors.

Aqua Frost Menthol

Aqua Frost Menthol is the Prismatic Series' take on menthol. It's cooler and more layered than the standard Vuse Alto Menthol pod. The base menthol hit is there, but it's backed by a subtle aquatic freshness that smooths out the finish and makes it less one-dimensional.

If you vape the regular Vuse Alto menthol and find it too sharp or too simple, Aqua Frost solves that. The cooling sensation is still strong, but it builds gradually instead of hitting all at once.

Each Vuse Alto Prismatic pod holds 1.8mL of e-liquid with 5% nicotine salt (50mg). The nicotine salt formulation delivers a smooth throat hit even at higher concentrations, which is why it works for people transitioning from cigarettes.

Prismatic Series Pods are compatible with the Vuse Alto device only. They won't work with the Vuse Pro, Vuse Solo, or any third-party pod systems. The magnetic connection is the same as standard Alto pods: snap the pod onto the top of the device and it locks into place.

The Vuse Alto Prismatic Series is built for vapers who already use the Alto system and want a more interesting flavor experience. If you've been vaping the same Golden Tobacco or Menthol pods for months and feel like something's missing, the Prismatic lineup gives you a reason to stay with the platform instead of switching devices.

It's also a good entry point for new Alto users who want to start with the best flavors available. Pair these pods with a Vuse Alto Power Unit Kit and you've got a premium setup for under $35 total.

If you prefer straightforward, no-frills flavors, the standard Vuse Alto All In One Kit with its regular pods will serve you fine. The Prismatic Series is for people who notice the difference and are willing to pay a small premium for it.

The Yovo JB50000 Pod uses a 1.0-ohm dual mesh coil. Two heating elements work together to heat e-liquid evenly across a wide surface area. The result is dense vapor and rich, consistent flavor from the first puff to the last.

No burnt taste halfway through. No weak hits at the end. The dual mesh design keeps flavor smooth and satisfying through the entire 15mL tank.

15mL Tank With 50K Puffs
